name: Is it better to repair or replace existing flooring?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace existing flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace depends on the extent of the damage, the age of the flooring, and your long-term goals. Minor issues like a few scratched hardwood planks or loose tiles can often be repaired cost-effectively. However, widespread damage, significant water damage, or outdated flooring that doesn't meet your aesthetic or functional needs usually warrants replacement. Replacing allows for a complete refresh, improved durability, and potentially higher home value. We can assess your current flooring and provide an honest recommendation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair minor damage, but replace if damage is widespread, due to water, or if you seek a complete aesthetic and functional upgrade. We can assess your specific situation.
